meta.name: Dhoop ki Deewar Hindi
meta.description: The genre happens to be a cross-border love story. Sara Sher Ali from Pakistan and Vishaal Malhotra find themselves caught in an ugly social media encounter when their fathers die in an age-old battle between the borders. They develop a bond and navigate through their loss together. "Two warring nation made a choice but who really paid the price" - while asking this thought provoking question, the series preaches #heartoverhate.

videos.title: Shahaadat Ke Baad
videos.overview: The media is keen to interview Vishal, Sara, and their siblings. New struggles emerge for both the families as they deal with opportunistic relatives, unwanted media trials, and their uncertain future.

videos.title: Maatam Ke Beech
videos.overview: The recent news of martyred soldiers puts things in perspective for Sara and Vishal. Vishal chats with Sara online and takes over Sunanda’s responsibilities. Amna faces a life-changing choice.

videos.title: Kadwe Sach
videos.overview: Sara's response on an online chat disturbs Vishal, so he calls her, but they end up blaming each other's fathers. Vishal discovers the side effects of Sunanda's medicines and seeks Sara's advice.

videos.title: Dushman Ka Dukh
videos.overview: Badar remains adamant about getting Sara married to his son, Hamaad. Vishal and Sara get caught in the crossfire between their relatives' selfish motives. Amna forbids Sara from talking to Vishal again.
